slot.brief: Arrange four simple words in dictionary order; words chosen so only the 2nd or 3rd letter breaks ties.

stem:
Arrange the following words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary.

1. Gaze
2. Game
3. Gate
4. Gave

verdicts.working: Compare letters after “Ga”: m < t < v < z, so the order is Game, Gate, Gave, Gaze (2, 3, 4, 1).

working:
All words begin with “Ga”; compare their third letters: m < t < v < z. Thus the order is Game, Gate, Gave, Gaze (2, 3, 4, 1). Each other option misorders at least one pair.
